name: Financial Monthly Account Closure
legacy_plsql: PROCEDURE prc_close_month(p_account_id IN VARCHAR2, p_fee IN NUMBER) IS v_balance NUMBER; BEGIN SELECT balance INTO v_balance FROM TBL_ACCOUNTS WHERE account_id = p_account_id FOR UPDATE; IF v_balance < p_fee THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'Insufficient funds for monthly fee'); END IF; UPDATE TBL_ACCOUNTS SET balance = balance - p_fee, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE account_id = p_account_id; INSERT INTO TBL_LEDGER_TRANSACTIONS (tx_id, account_id, amount, tx_type, created_at) VALUES (SYS_GUID(), p_account_id, p_fee, 'MONTHLY_FEE', SYSTIMESTAMP); COMMIT; EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Account does not exist'); END prc_close_month;

Generación obligatoria de registro contable con partida doble
Manejo de excepción NO_DATA_FOUND retornando código fiscal

name: Audit Logging Trigger Procedure
legacy_plsql: PROCEDURE prc_audit_login(p_user_id IN VARCHAR2, p_ip IN VARCHAR2) IS BEGIN INSERT INTO TBL_SECURITY_AUDIT (audit_id, user_id, ip_address, login_time) VALUES (SYS_GUID(), p_user_id, p_ip, SYSTIMESTAMP); END prc_audit_login;
